g.text: Post Acquisition Subscription Changes Order Flow
Flow for subscription level changes, suspension, resumption, renewal, cancellation.
There is a separate flow for rate plan changes such as add ons or upsells. Owner Transfer
and Terms & Conditions are left out as a customer should never drive these actions.
For clarity details of payment gateway and tax integrations have been intentionaly excluded.
In this diagram 'Portal' is your web site or application running on your server(s) where
prospects or your sales team can manage the customer's subscriptions. Your customer
or sales is sitting in front of the Browser.
Order Preview and new total display is optional. If contract permits Browser may also supply
cancellation date and so may be entitled to a credit. With early cancellation Zuora automatically
creates the appropriate credit. Additional action is needed to issue a refund from that credit,
Zuora default recommendation is to apply the credit to a future invoice, not issue a refund.
Order incl. Account Id, Subscription Id,
Send email to customer confirming order
